create.name: Sandrine Harris
create.bio:
Sandrine Harris is a somatic educator and meditation guide based in western Massachusetts, where she sees people in person at a practice in Great Barrington and also works online. A former professional dancer, she began leading creative movement classes for adults in Prague in 1999 and took up meditation herself in 2006. She later qualified in Somatic Experiencing and the Feldenkrais Method, registered as a somatic movement educator, trained as a death doula, and studied Nonviolent Communication; among the meditation teachers she names is Sharon Salzberg. Until 2022 she co-led a 200-hour training for mindfulness facilitators.

Her offerings go out under the name Emergent Nature. The main one since 2023 is MARROW, a multi-day group process that weaves somatic awareness, free movement, rest, creative mark-making and several styles of meditation, which she has led at Kripalu and Omega in the United States and in Australia, England, Scotland and Austria. She also runs weekend meditation retreats, trauma-sensitive mindfulness groups, seasonal walks and rituals outdoors, and a gentle floor-to-standing dance class called Kinesoma that is open to every body. Her approach is slow, sensory and earth-connected, inviting people to listen to the body and to the living world around them.

courses.title: Moving Through Stillness: Somatic Meditations to Support Your New Year Transition
courses.description: A weekend retreat at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, to close the year with meditation, guided movement and quiet reflection. Sessions mix contemplative practice, writing and body awareness, with Kripalu's daily yoga classes and meals included in the stay. Some meditation experience helps, but newcomers are welcome and chairs are provided.
courses.price: Tuition: $350 per person, plus required accommodation

courses.title: MARROW
courses.description: Her signature group process, held as a multi-day retreat at centres in the United States and abroad. Participants explore somatic awareness, unscripted movement, rest, journaling, embodied mark-making and different forms of meditation, often outdoors. No previous experience is needed.

courses.title: Group Experiences: Mindfulness, Meditative Movement and Kinesoma
courses.description: Her regular classes and workshops, online and in person: trauma-sensitive mindfulness meditation, embodiment for daily life, seasonal walks and rituals in nature, and the Kinesoma movement class. Kinesoma starts gently on the floor and builds into moving around the room, with no dance background required.
